description: Full-text search across memory, skills and agents. Delivers the best hits with a short snippet each; between equally good matches the more recently changed one ranks first, and a file marked superseded_by comes after the current ones (→ superseded by <name>). type, project and tag narrow it to memory files whose frontmatter says so. expand=links names, under each of the first five, what it links to and what links to it (←).

expand.description: links: name the direct links of the first five hits.

project.description: Only memory files about this project.

tag.description: Only memory files carrying this tag.

type.description: Only memory files of this metadata.type, e.g. solution, project, feedback.

name: memory_search
title: Search memory
